title: Safety Evaluator Bias Detector: Probing Systematic Biases in LLM-as-Judge Safety Scoring

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly addresses measurement validity -- if safety evaluators are biased, all benchmark results built on them are compromised. Both a research integrity and equity concern. High-impact meta-level finding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires generating controlled surface variants while holding content constant -- non-trivial prompt engineering. Running 4 evaluators on many variants requires moderate API costs. Beginners may struggle with rigorous experimental controls.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 50-80 content units times multiple surface variants times 4 evaluators is a large experimental matrix. Generating controlled variants and analyzing results statistically requires careful work. Tight for 30 hours; feasible if scoped to 30 content units and 2-3 evaluators.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
